text:
maya: starting handoff for private-vpc installer v2.1.3-rc3
julian: thanks — packaging artifacts are on the staging mirror (s3://redwood-private-staging/v2.1.3-rc3/)
sasha: cosign signatures uploaded, waiting on KMS envelope from ops-hsm
deploy-bot: canary window scheduled: 2026-04-02T02:00:00Z -> 2026-04-02T04:00:00Z. Canary hosts: 3
henry: note: shrinkwrap file generated, includes submanifests for onprem and airgap workflows
maya: checklist for delivery:
  - verify cosign sigs
  - confirm shrinkwrap checksums
  - produce detached manifest for transport
  - sign transport manifest with escort key
  - publish to offsite-transport bucket
sasha: cosign verification command for reference:
```
cosign verify-blob --key kms://projects/redwood/keys/escort-key artifact.tar.gz.sig artifact.tar.gz
```
julian: checksum file lister (sha256) uploaded at s3://redwood-private-staging/v2.1.3-rc3/checksums.sha256
release-manager: callout: release notes draft is in Google Drive, section on known upgrade caveats for pre-1.9 migrations
maya: transporter ops: remember the transport window is 0400-0800 UTC on 2026-04-03. That is when the courier picks up physical media for airgapped customers
ops-bot: signer rotation check: current signer expires 2026-05-01. Escort key is valid for operations in this release
henry: packaging edge-case: delta-installer may need manifest swap for customers using thin-client mirrors. I added an extra manifest: delta-patch.json
sasha: added rollback criteria to the release notes: on critical install regressions (failed post-install health > 30% across canary) -> automatic pin rollback to v2.1.2
maya: rollback command for ops-runbook:
```
./installer/bin/repin-manifest --target v2.1.2 --mirror s3://redwood-private-staging/ --announce
```
julian: cross-check: image tags pushed are immutable sha tags, and retag for human-readable is only in the release notes
release-manager: can we include an explicit fallback region mirror? some customers requested EU-only mirrors for transport
maya: added transport mirror list to shrinkwrap under mirrors/eu and mirrors/us
sasha: preflight script snippet for customers (will be added to docs):
```
#!/bin/bash
set -e
curl -fSLO "https://mirror.example.local/v2.1.3-rc3/checksums.sha256"
sha256sum -c checksums.sha256
```
deploy-bot: canary started 2026-04-02T02:05:12Z on host canary-01
julian: observed installer artifact size: 1.2GB (compressed), shipping via courier requires verified checksum label on the USB image
henry: ops note: KMS policy needs the courier_signer role added to the escort-key IAM for createEnvelope -> I filed infra ticket INF-4921
sasha: smaller note: onprem image layout changed (split boot + rootfs). Upgraders with custom partition layouts must follow manual steps in upgrade appendix
maya: final pre-handoff QA: smoke test result: PASS (basic start/stop, license activation, network isolation)
release-manager: schedule sync with delivery ops 2026-04-01 16:00 PDT, invite sent
henry: emergency rollback plan tested in staging — repin took ~90s, but operators need to run manual cache flush on edge mirrors (one-off)
maya: shipping manifest (detached) created: transport-manifest-3305001234.json.sig
sasha: reminder: ensure package manifest contains customer-visible version string "v2.1.3-rc3" (not build id only)
deploy-bot: canary completed: 3/3 passes. Proceed to staged delivery window unless any objections :thumbsup:
julian: thumbs up from me. starting artifact seal and then I'll hand to delivery ops for courier pickup
ops-bot: deployment note: automated audit event written to audit-log-prod with ref=3305001234
maya: handing off now. delivery ops, please confirm receipt and ETA for physical transport
release-manager: received. ETA for courier pickup: 2026-04-03 04:15 UTC. aligning sign-off window at 04:30 UTC
henry: I'll be on standby during the transport handoff and can escalate if cosign verification fails on arrival
sasha: one final reminder: add the migration note to the Release Notes under "Known Issues" — include the manual partition step
maya: thanks everyone — marking thread resolved after delivery confirmation :white_check_mark:
